def encodeFilename(s, for_subprocess=False):
    """
    @param s The name of the file
    """
    assert type(s) == compat_str
    if sys.version_info >= (3, 0):
        return s
    if not for_subprocess and sys.platform == 'win32' and (sys.getwindowsversion()[0] >= 5):
        return s
    if sys.platform.startswith('java'):
        return s
    return s.encode(get_subprocess_encoding(), 'ignore')

import pytest

from youtube_dl.postprocessor.common import PostProcessor


def test_run_returns_empty_list_and_same_information():
    pp = PostProcessor()
    information = {'filepath': '/tmp/video.mp4', 'title': 'video'}

    files_to_delete, info = pp.run(information)

    assert files_to_delete == []
    assert isinstance(files_to_delete, list)
    assert info is information
    assert info == {'filepath': '/tmp/video.mp4', 'title': 'video'}


def test_run_does_not_mutate_information():
    pp = PostProcessor()
    information = {'filepath': '/tmp/video.mp4'}
    snapshot = dict(information)

    files_to_delete, info = pp.run(information)

    assert files_to_delete == []
    assert info == snapshot
    assert information == snapshot


def test_run_with_downloader_returns_empty_list():
    sentinel_downloader = object()
    pp = PostProcessor(downloader=sentinel_downloader)
    information = {}

    files_to_delete, info = pp.run(information)

    assert pp._downloader is sentinel_downloader
    assert files_to_delete == []
    assert info is information


def test_run_returns_fresh_list_each_call():
    pp = PostProcessor()
    information = {'filepath': '/tmp/video.mp4'}

    first_files, first_info = pp.run(information)
    second_files, second_info = pp.run(information)

    assert first_files == [] and second_files == []
    assert first_files is not second_files
    assert first_info is information and second_info is information


def test_run_does_not_touch_filesystem(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
    target = tmp_path / 'video.mp4'
    target.write_bytes(b'data')

    pp = PostProcessor()
    information = {'filepath': str(target)}

    files_to_delete, info = pp.run(information)

    assert files_to_delete == []
    assert info is information
    assert target.exists()
    assert target.read_bytes() == b'data'

import pytest

from youtube_dl.postprocessor.common import PostProcessor


class _FakeDownloader(object):
    """Minimal stand-in exposing only the ``params`` attribute."""

    def __init__(self, params):
        self.params = params


def test_configuration_args_returns_default_when_key_absent():
    pp = PostProcessor(_FakeDownloader({}))
    assert pp._configuration_args() == []
    assert pp._configuration_args(['--default-arg']) == ['--default-arg']


def test_configuration_args_returns_configured_list():
    pp = PostProcessor(_FakeDownloader({'postprocessor_args': ['--a', '--b']}))
    assert pp._configuration_args() == ['--a', '--b']
    # explicit default must be ignored when the param is present
    assert pp._configuration_args(['--ignored']) == ['--a', '--b']


def test_configuration_args_none_value_falls_back_to_default():
    pp = PostProcessor(_FakeDownloader({'postprocessor_args': None}))
    assert pp._configuration_args(['--fallback']) == ['--fallback']


def test_configuration_args_empty_list_is_returned_as_is():
    pp = PostProcessor(_FakeDownloader({'postprocessor_args': []}))
    assert pp._configuration_args(['--fallback']) == []


def test_configuration_args_rejects_non_list_value():
    pp = PostProcessor(_FakeDownloader({'postprocessor_args': '--not-a-list'}))
    with pytest.raises(AssertionError):
        pp._configuration_args()


def test_configuration_args_does_not_mutate_default():
    default = ['--keep']
    pp = PostProcessor(_FakeDownloader({}))
    result = pp._configuration_args(default)
    assert result == ['--keep']
    assert default == ['--keep']
